newsitem.title: UK: UK car production drops 5.8% in six months to June.
newsitem.headline: UK car production drops 5.8% in six months to June.

text.p: Total British car production fell by a seasonally-adjusted 5.8 percent in the six months to June, the Office for National Statistics said on Friday.
Production allocated for the home market fell by 8.3 percent while export production dropped by 3.8 percent.
Compared to the same period a year ago, total car production rose by 4.6 percent on a seasonally adjusted basis. Export production was up 16.7 percent but home production slid by 8.2 percent.
Total commercial vehicle production was 4.7 percent lower, seasonally adjusted, for the six months ending June 1997 and 3.3 percent down on the same period a year ago.
